definition: Growing thickly and abundantly, with many leaves or flowers.
author: Kenneth Grahame
quote: Purple loosestrife arrived early, shaking luxuriant tangled locks along the edge of the mirror whence its own face laughed back at it.
example_sentence: The greenhouse was full of luxuriant ferns.
